metadata.title: Retro Glamour Portrait with Cobalt Accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast close-up beauty portrait of a blonde woman featuring a voluminous 1960s-inspired beehive hairstyle, intense cobalt blue smokey-eye makeup, and sparkling heart-shaped accessories against a deep blue background.
coreVisualRelationships: Monochromatic blue harmony between the background, eye makeup, and nail polish.
Warm skin tones and blonde hair contrasting against the cool-toned environment.
High-sheen textures on the lips and jewelry balancing the matte skin finish.
coreInvariants: Voluminous half-up beehive hairstyle with face-framing waves.
Heavy, saturated blue eyeshadow extending to the brow bone.
Heart-shaped motif repeated in earrings and rings.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, head and shoulders, slightly angled to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, emphasized by the dark blue makeup and central placement.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the eyes down to the glossy lips, then following the hand placement up to the heart-shaped earring.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal, primarily the deep blue backdrop in the upper corners.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm honey blonde (hair) and tanned peach (skin).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white (specular highlights on jewelry and eyes).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the blues; high value contrast between the dark makeup and the light hair.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a studio beauty shot of a blonde woman with a 60s bouffant hairstyle, wearing heavy blue eyeshadow and glossy lips, posed against a solid dark blue wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply sharp specular highlights to the jewelry and enhance the saturation of the blue tones in post-processing.

verificationChecks: Is the hair volume consistent with a 60s beehive?
Is the blue eyeshadow saturated and blended?
Are the heart-shaped accessories present and sparkling?

adjustableVariables: Specific shape of the jewelry (e.g., stars instead of hearts)
mustRedesign: Avoid any specific brand logos on the jewelry
Ensure the hand pose does not obscure the facial features

mustAchieve: Clean, sharp focus on the eyelashes and iris
Smooth skin texture without losing natural pore detail
Defined hair strands within the voluminous style

postGenerationChecks: Verify the 'glint' effect on the earrings.
Ensure the blue of the nails matches the blue of the eyes.
Confirm the hair has a distinct 'half-up' structure.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a retro 1960s silhouette with modern high-saturation color blocking, focusing on a single primary hue for all cosmetic and environmental accents.
